<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only -->

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g., I'm always frustrated when trying to access GOP framebuffers because...).

## Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Keep in mind: **KiloOS is written exclusively in Assembly** targeting UEFI Class 3 environments. Propose how this fits into low-level modules (e.g., `myboot.asm`, drivers, etc.).

## Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any references to UEFI specifications, registers, or architectural considerations.
